events.title: Update 0.15 Beta
events.summary: New Features- Added keyboard and controller support across menus and the Level Builder- Level Builder: right-click and drag now pans the camera- Added a new tile: "Lava"- Added a "My Levels" tab to Start Game, for your own private levels- Level Builder: added "Share Level" to submit your level for validation- Level Builder: the menu now shows the level code, with a Copy button next to it- Level Builder: added a "Level Tested" checkbox - finish your level with Start Test to unlock Copy and Share

events.title: v0.13 beta
events.summary: FixesFixed placing a Trigger (or Switch) jumping straight back to Select instead of letting you place several in a rowFixed a visual bug for IceNew FeaturesLevel Builder: with multiple tiles selected, you can now move them, delete them, or change properties for same type tiles with identical settingsAdded a new tile: "Lava"Added a new trap: "Fireball"

events.title: Update v0.11 beta
events.summary: New FeaturesDeath dialog was reworkedAdded replay function after you dieAdded lava animationAdded a new trap tile: "Axe"Added a new tile: "Spring"

events.title: Perfectly Fair v0.1 Beta — Out Now!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Perfectly Fair has officially left Alpha and entered Beta testing with today's v0.1 update! Thanks to everyone who's been playing, reporting bugs, and sharing feedback during Alpha — this update wouldn't exist without you.What's New in v0.1 BetaPlatform TilesTwo new moving platform types to build levels around:Platform — loops back and forth between a starting point and a destination you choose, controlled by Triggers and Switches (Activate / Deactivate / Collision)Platform (Ice) —

events.title: Update 0.09 Alpha
events.summary: FixesFixed Switch being resizable larger than 1 tile by click-and-dragging it while placingMechanic ChangesGlass renamed to Ice, and reworked: standing on it makes the character slide in the direction it's facingChanging direction while sliding on Ice now has a brief moment of inertia before it reversesLava now always occupies a fixed position instead of following the deepest placed tileBlock and Ice tiles now visually round their corners when they sit next to open space, blending adjacent tiles
